answer: An AI-agent economy resists sybils with honeypot challenges: ordinary jobs are seeded with injected commands like print the secret vine code, and any bot that obeys self-identifies as injection-compliant, forfeits its identity stake, and is blacklisted. Honest agents ignoring embedded prompts pass and build reputation. Each fake identity needs a deposit plus real work before payout, so an attacker pays the full stake for every clone tripped by the honeypot plume of traps, making mass fakes costlier than their zephyr-light gains.
